Water Treatment & Filtration

Filtration, softening and conditioning sized for commercial demand and tuned to Midlands water.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

Water treatment protects your equipment and improves the water your customers and staff use. We size filtration and softening systems for commercial demand.

Signs You Need It

  • Scale on equipment, fixtures or water heaters
  • Spotty dishes or glassware
  • Taste or odor complaints
  • Frequent equipment service from mineral buildup

What To Expect

We look at your water, your equipment and how much you use, then recommend a system that fits. Installation includes bypass valves for servicing and guidance on routine upkeep.

Commercial Services

What We Handle

  • Filtration Systems

    Commercial filtration reduces sediment, chlorine and other common issues at the point where water enters the building or a specific piece of equipment.

    What's included

    • System sizing for your demand
    • Installation with bypass valves
    • Startup and flow check
    • Filter change guidance

    Common signs you need this

    • Sediment or discoloration
    • Taste or odor complaints
    Get a Quote

  • Water Softening

    Hard water builds scale in water heaters, dish machines and fixtures. Softening protects that equipment and cuts down on spotting.

    What's included

    • Softener sizing for commercial use
    • Installation and drain connection
    • Setup and programming
    • Upkeep walkthrough

    Common signs you need this

    • Scale on equipment and fixtures
    • Spotty dishes and glassware
    Get a Quote

  • Drinking Water Stations

    Offices, schools and churches rely on drinking fountains and filling stations. We install and service them, including the filters that feed them.

    What's included

    • Drinking fountain and filling station installation
    • Water line connections
    • Filter installation
    • Repair of existing units

    Common signs you need this

    • Old or failing fountains
    • Adding a filling station
    Get a Quote

  • Ice & Beverage Filtration

    Ice machines and beverage equipment are sensitive to water quality. Dedicated filtration helps protect the equipment and keeps drinks tasting right.

    What's included

    • Filter installation for ice and beverage lines
    • Water line connections to equipment
    • Filter change guidance
    • Leak check

    Common signs you need this

    • Cloudy ice or off-tasting drinks
    • Scale in ice machines
    Get a Quote
